```story
### 2026-10-31 · Win: First outside user finished the flow
- Problem: Nobody outside the studio had used the scanner end to end.
- Chase's call: "Send it to one tester, not ten."
- Decision and why: One tester with a screen recording, over a wide link share, so every stumble was visible.
- Result: Finished in 2 minutes 40 seconds; one label confused them, cut load time from 2400 ms to 900 ms.
- Story angle: Small, watched tests over big, silent launches.
```
